To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the user's awareness and trust in the results of a visual analytics system depends on the extent to which the user is aware of the uncertainties propagated in the process.
the user's awareness and trust in a visualisation system depends on the user's perception of the uncertainty propagated through the visual analytics system.

the user's perception and awareness of the uncertainties in the visual analytics system is influenced by the user's cognitive and perceptual biases and that this affects the user trust building in the results of the visual analytics system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of uncertainty, awareness and trust in the knowledge generation model for the field of visual analytics.
how the user can better cope with the uncertainties that are introduced through the process of knowledge generation in visual analytics.
understanding and supporting human trust building in the presence of uncertainties in visual analytics systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the human's trust in visual analytics systems is influenced by their perception of uncertainty and their understanding of the system's awareness of uncertainty.
the user's awareness is a critical component in visual analytics, and that the design of visual analytics systems should be informed by the user's awareness.
the role of uncertainty, awareness, and trust in visual analytics is a complex one and needs to be considered carefully to ensure effective decision making.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the user's awareness and trust building are crucial to the success of a visual analytics system, and the system should support the user in building awareness of the underlying propagated uncertainties and trust in the results.
uncertainty-aware systems can help users to make better decisions by making the uncertainty explicit and thus increasing their awareness.
the user should be provided with the means to understand the uncertainty and trust in the visual analytics systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user's awareness is the key factor that influences the user's trust in visual analytics systems.

uncertainty-awareness is not a simple matter of visualising the propagated uncertainty, but requires an understanding of the cognitive processes that affect user's awareness of propagated uncertainty and how these affect the user's trust in the system.

uncertainty is an inherent part of the knowledge generation process in visual analytics, and that the user's awareness and perception of the uncertainty is a key factor in the user's trust in the results.
